diffs.text: Power: Bag of Toys Hold the Ability button to open your Bag of Toys and select one of two random Toys. The Bag of Toys enters a cooldown state and cannot be opened again until it expires. Special Items: Toys Toys damage healthy Survivors and inflict injured Survivors with a Torture effect. Hold the Power button to ready a Toy and tap the Attack button to use it. Each Toy is single-use. Acid Bottle: Throw Acid Bottles at Survivors or create Acid Puddles. Causes the Torture effect. Flail: Perform a sweeping attack that can strike over certain obstacles. Causes the Torture effect. Handgun: Fire a bullet. Causes the Torture effect. Flamethrower: Shoot a stream of fire that can inflame Pallets, Windows, and Generators. Causes the Torture effect. Bike Horn: Reveal Survivors with Killer Instinct and apply Oblivious for X seconds. Reset the timer on any active Torture effects. Use a Toy to inflict a Torture effect on an injured Survivor. Then, use a different Toy on the Survivor to down them and inflict Terrified. Special Action: Taunt Press the Ability button to Taunt. Taunting a Terrified Survivor who is hooked or downed grants 1 point of Deadliness to all Toys. This removes the Survivor's Terrified status effect. Deadliness When a Toy applies the Torture status effect, it gains one point of Deadliness. Upon reaching maximum Deadliness, the Toy can down injured Survivors. When the Bike Horn reaches maximum Deadliness it will interrupt any Survivors repairing a Generator or healing, and instantly regress their progress

diffs.text: Introducing the The Subdivisions realm with the Hartshorne Mall, a new environment loaded with lore where players can experience a new environment in Dead by Daylight. "Dwight was no older than five when he lost his parents in the Hartshorne Mall. A place that was once a magical escape twisted into something more horrifying. He ducked behind a door marked 'Employees Only', and found himself somewhere completely different: somewhere quiet, but no less disturbing. Something called out to him. He followed the call... and woke up at home, his parents pleading him to tell where he went. He did not answer. He could not remember."

Finisher mori
Power mori
Memento Mori offering and Perk mori
Starting with The Terrifier, all upcoming Killers will adhere to this Mori system update

diffs.text: Not all Killers have or will have a Power mori, but rather that any Moris they do have will fall into these categories
Each mori type is superseded by the one above it, as long as the trigger conditions are all met, meaning only a single "Kill" interaction prompt is available at one time
Activating all moris will use a standardized keybinding of the Killer's Attack input
This system update will roll out to previously released Killers over time

lines: When the trial starts, and after a Generator is completed, you earn 1 Token, up to 5. (NEW)
When the Killer gets within 20m of you, spend 1 Token. Then, for the next 13/14/15s:
You see the Aura of Pallets and Windows within 32m
You see the Auras of other Survivors
You see the Killer's Aura
changes.devNote: Dev note: Dark Sense was updated as a generic alternative to reveal pallets and windows within a radius. In 10.2.0, it activated upon generator completion, meaning if it didn't get a chance to trigger, players would lose value. With this PTB, we are adding a token system to allow players to have more chances to activate the perk.

changes.devNote: Dev note: Dark Arrogance regained its successful basic-attack cooldown in 10.2.2, but we felt it could be buffed a little further. To offset this, we're reducing the vault speed bonus while also decreasing the penalty to blinds, pallet stuns, and we're adding missed attack cooldowns to the penalties.

items: Fixed an issue with Survivor Bots trying to cleanse totems when a Player is already interacting with it.
Tentative fix for Survivor Bots not unhooking while walking into the hooked Survivor.
Fixed an issue where the aura of completed generators became visible after controlling Victor (The Twins) during the End Game Collapse.
Fixed an issue where The Judgment was able to block a Survivor from escaping past the 32m range.
Fixed an issue where the camera was too far away from The Good Guy.
Fixed an issue where injured Survivors hit by The Slasher's spike would not always get correctly pinned to nearby surfaces.
Fixed an issue in Raccoon City Police Station where a Killer can block a hook and prevent a Survivor from unhooking.
Fixed an issue in Pale Rose where a Survivor could not interact with one side of a generator in the corner of the map.
Fixed an issue in Grim Pantry where collisions were missing under the stairs of the small structure.
Fixed an issue in Temple of Purgation where the Nurse could not blink through some walls in the underground section.
Fixed an issue in Disturbed Ward where Survivors are clipping through the doors of lockers.
Fixed an issue where the Perk Lay Waste had the Generator regression speed increase applied before other Generator regression Perks were triggered.
Fixed an issue where the Perk Merciless Storm caused a Skill Check to automatically fail after the second Skill Check when playing against The Doctor.
Fixed an issue where there was an inconsistency in the activation of Hex: The Third Seal.
Fixed an issue where the perk Chemical Trap was unable to explode when placed on a pallet at the same time it was being broken by certain Killer Powers.
Fixed an issue where the Wiggle Skill Check Bar was starting at an incorrect position.
Fixed an issue where The Onryo Condemned HUD indicator remained dim after a TV teleportation near a Survivor with active stacks.
Fixed an issue where a Bloodweb Error would frequently occur when selecting the Loadout Tab while the Bloodweb was progressing.
